record.context_brief: Which abelian varieties are isogenous to Jacobians
record.original_question: Given an abelian variety A, does there exist an algebraic curve C such that A is isogenous to the Jacobian of C?

evidence.quote: (8.0.1) Question. Given an abelian variety A; does there exist an algebraic curve C such that there is an isogeny between A and the Jacobian of C ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $A$ be an abelian variety over $k$ of dimension $g$. An algebraic curve $C$ over $k$ (smooth, projective, and geometrically connected) gives rise to its Jacobian variety $J(C)$, an abelian variety of dimension equal to the genus of $C$. Two abelian varieties $B_1, B_2$ over $k$ are said to be isogenous if there exists a surjective homomorphism $B_1 \to B_2$ with finite kernel.

Question: For which abelian varieties $A$ over $k$ does there exist an algebraic curve $C$ over $k$ such that $A$ is isogenous to $J(C)$? In particular, given $g \geq 4$, is every abelian variety of dimension $g$ isogenous to a Jacobian, or are there abelian varieties not isogenous to any Jacobian?
artifact.status_search_result: Over $\mathbb{C}$, a countability argument shows that for $g \geq 4$ not every abelian variety is isogenous to a Jacobian. Over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$, Chai–Oort (2012, conditional on André–Oort) and Tsimerman (2012, unconditional) showed that there exist abelian varieties not isogenous to any Jacobian, and more recent work has extended this to Hodge-generic examples. The related Coleman–Oort conjecture, predicting that for $g\geq 8$ no positive-dimensional special subvariety of $\mathcal{A}_g$ is generically contained in the Torelli locus, remains open. A complete characterization of which abelian varieties are isogenous to Jacobians is not known.

status_evidence.title: Abelian varieties isogenous to a Jacobian
status_evidence.snippet: Chai–Oort paper showing (conditional on André–Oort) existence of abelian varieties not isogenous to a Jacobian.
status_evidence.claim: Conditional construction of abelian varieties not isogenous to any Jacobian over the algebraic numbers.

status_evidence.title: Abelian varieties isogenous to no Jacobian
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of abelian varieties over the algebraic numbers not isogenous to any Jacobian.
status_evidence.claim: Unconditional existence (Tsimerman and later extensions) of abelian varieties not isogenous to any Jacobian.

status_evidence.title: Abelian varieties with no power isogenous to a Jacobian
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the stronger question of whether some power of A is isogenous to a Jacobian.
status_evidence.claim: The refined question concerning powers remains an active research area.
